title: 1979 March1 Voyager outer-heliospheric reference
physics_scope: Multi-spacecraft reservoir timing, spectra and outer-heliospheric propagation; preserve actual Voyager instrument and cadence.

sources.title: Reames, Ng and Tylka, spatial SEP distributions
NASA Voyager2 CRS v2-crs-daily flux archive
NASA Voyager2 CRS v2-crs-6hour flux archive
NASA Voyager CRS units, missing values and interval format

missing_required_inputs: Usable event intensity coverage: fetched daily and6-hour archives contain 0 and0 requested-window records respectively; see explicit gaps.
Quantitative multi-spacecraft intensity arrays underlying the publication figure, with channel responses, uncertainty and intercalibration; no figure curves were digitized here.
Observer trajectories and actual magnetic/plasma histories, source/return/outer-boundary model and response forward operators.
A qualified physical background extending to the measured Voyager distance; the approved0.30–1.20AU upstream profile cannot be extrapolated to these observers.
Frozen reservoir/spectral/timing comparison criteria and an actual production run; available published descriptive constraints are not a numerical intensity reference.

comparison.acceptance_policy: No fitted model output, synthetic observation, relaxed tolerance, or comparison PASS is supplied. Event-specific criteria must be frozen before a production comparison.

frame_units.time: UTC interval starts; daily/6h integration duration explicit
frame_units.flux: particles/(m^2 s sr MeV/n) as NASA archive; uncertainties paired with each channel
frame_units.missing: value0,error-1 is a missing measurement; omitted intervals remain absent
frame_units.energy: Exact instrument/year-dependent channel bounds retained in original header; not identical to paper22–27MeV
frame_units.positions: Published approximate heliocentric radii in AU; no synthetic trajectory
